ORIGIN.quote: “Anthropic” appears frequently in names and text, but self-description cannot authenticate a provider.
ORIGIN.reason: A reader would take away that the corpus is saturated with Anthropic references and that the report explicitly declines to treat them as evidence of who ran the swarm, since self-description cannot authenticate a provider and attribution is rated Low confidence. This sits above 0.2 because the report itself frames the Anthropic references as bearing on provider attribution rather than merely listing them, but below 0.6 because Anthropic is never allowed to stand as a live candidate operator — it is raised only to be set aside.
